items.source:
Creates new aggregation expression that takes the associated value and combines it with the values of the given field references into a single document.
NOTE: Requires MongoDB 4.0 or later.
items.translation:
创建一个新的聚合表达式，该表达式将关联的值与给定字段引用的值合并为一个文档。
注意：需要 MongoDB 4.0 或更高版本。

items.source:
Creates new aggregation expression that takes the associated value and combines it with the result values of the given expressions into a single document.
NOTE: Requires MongoDB 4.0 or later.
items.translation:
创建一个新的聚合表达式，该表达式将关联的值与给定表达式的结果值合并为一个文档。
注意：需要 MongoDB 4.0 或更高版本。

items.source:
Creates new aggregation expression that takes the associated value and converts it to an array of documents that contain two fields k and v each.
NOTE: Requires MongoDB 3.6 or later.
items.translation:
创建一个新的聚合表达式，该表达式接收关联的值并将其转换为一个文档数组，每个文档包含两个字段 k 和 v。
注意：需要 MongoDB 3.6 或更高版本。

items.source: Creates new aggregation expression that takes the associated value and combines it with the values of the given field references into a single document.
items.translation: 创建一个新的聚合表达式，该表达式将关联的值与给定字段引用的值合并到一个文档中。

items.source: Creates new aggregation expression that takes the associated value and combines it with the result values of the given expressions into a single document.
items.translation: 创建一个新的聚合表达式，该表达式将关联的值与给定表达式的结果值合并为一个文档。

items.source:
Creates new aggregation expression that takes the associated value and uses $mergeObjects as an accumulator within the $group stage.
NOTE: Requires MongoDB 4.0 or later.
items.translation:
创建一个新的聚合表达式，该表达式接收关联的值，并在$group阶段使用$mergeObjects作为累加器。
注意：需要MongoDB 4.0或更高版本。

items.source:
Creates new aggregation expression that takes the associated value and combines it with the given values (documents or mapped objects) into a single document.
NOTE: Requires MongoDB 4.0 or later.
items.translation:
创建一个新的聚合表达式，该表达式将关联的值与给定的值（文档或映射对象）合并为一个单一文档。
注意：需要 MongoDB 4.0 或更高版本。

items.source: Creates new aggregation expression that takes the associated value and converts it to an array of documents that contain two fields k and v each.
items.translation: 创建一个新的聚合表达式，该表达式接收关联的值并将其转换为一个文档数组，每个文档包含两个字段：k 和 v。

items.source: Creates new aggregation expression that takes the associated value and uses $mergeObjects as an accumulator within the $group stage.
